newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: CZECH CNB-120 INDEX FALLS 9.1 POINTS TO 822.8.
newsitem.headline: CZECH CNB-120 INDEX FALLS 9.1 POINTS TO 822.8.

text.p: The CNB-120 index, a broad daily measure of Czech equities, fell 9.1 points on Wednesday to 822.8, the Czech National Bank (CNB) said.
Five of the ten sectoral indices lost, with the construction index losing the most, down 1.84 percent to 1,020.7 points.
Of the five sectoral indices posting modest gains, the investment funds index rose most, up 0.84 percent to 1,050.2 points.
